A delicious Bihari-style Egg Curry made the desi way, with whole garlic pods that add an incredible depth of flavour to the curry! It's spicy, rich, garlicky and one of my favourite ways to make egg curry at home.
Pair it with some hot tandoori roti, regular roti or rice, and you've got a simple, comforting meal that's absolutely delicious. Do give this recipe a try!
The full written recipe is in the description below.
